name: 4P Foods
tagline: 4P Foods in Washington, District of Columbia, 20024
description: 4P Foods is a CSA (community-supported agriculture) farm in 350 G Street SW, WA. Members receive a season-long share of the farm's harvest, supporting local growing while getting fresh, seasonal produce. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
